title: Texas property tax protest deadline
rule: To be entitled to a hearing, an owner files a written notice of protest with the appraisal review board not later than May 15 or the 30th day after the appraisal notice was delivered, whichever is later. If the last day falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal state or national holiday, filing on the next regular business day is timely. Texas lists its national and state holidays by statute; optional holidays are listed separately.

citation.authority: Tex. Tax Code 41.44(a)(1) and 1.06; Tex. Gov't Code 662.003
